summary: Game Your Game, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 23, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing full commercial availability of GameGolf KZN AI, its next-generation golf shot-tracking, GPS and AI-analytics platform, now purchasable at gamegolf.com following a limited release. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is stated. This is an ordinary product-availability current report, not a special situation, so no risk-arb angle applies; watch only for commercial adoption disclosures.
